title: Senior Consultant – Global Transaction Banking (GTB)
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).


If you are passionate about corporate banking solutions , trade finance , and cash management , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on Global Transaction Banking (GTB) .
  • Drive and support initiatives in:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).
  • Cash Management (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).
  • Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables within defined time and cost parameters .
  • Prepare and deliver project reporting to senior management through presentations and executive updates.
  • Coordinate workshops and meetings with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.
  • Define and execute testing initiatives in collaboration with IT teams.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.
  • Support change management and successful adoption of new systems or processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PIX (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulations (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and international trade finance standards .
  • Proven experience participating in the implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking , or related sectors.
  • Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).
  • Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).
  • Proven skills in requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .
  • Familiarity with corporate banking platforms such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.
  • Experience with digital and API-based GTB solutions .
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Spanish is a strong plus.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.
  • Familiarity with process automation (RPA) and liquidity dashboards (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience in operational and liquidity risk management .
  • Exposure to cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPA-20, CTP, CFA ; graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.


Preferred Education

  • Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.
  • Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:
  • Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.
  • MBA focused on strategic management and stakeholder engagement.
  • Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead strategic GTB transformation projects for top-tier financial institutions.
  • Work in a dynamic and international environment with exposure to high-impact banking initiatives.
  • Continuous learning, certifications, and professional development plans .
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • Flexible work model (Hybrid – São Paulo).


CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • VR - R$ 800,00
  • A collaborative work environment, internal events, and global mobility opportunities.


Learn more about us: nfq.es | LinkedIn NFQ

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)


Ready to lead GTB transformation and make an impact in corporate banking? Apply now!

title: Country Leader, Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.


The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.


Key Responsibilities


1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively


2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.


3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.


4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.


5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.


6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.


7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).


Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!


About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.


Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.



Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient


Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. title: Analista fiscal Jr
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Analista Fiscal, você irá:


  • Conhecimento sobre fato gerador de impostos indiretos: ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS COFINS;
  • Análise de documentos fiscais: NFe, CTe NFSe;
  • Vivência em apuração de impostos;
  • Conhecimento sobre direito a crédito de impostos;
  • Conhecimento em obrigações acessórias: SPED ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, DIRBI
  • Conhecimento em registro de notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Conhecimento sobre regras de carta de correção;
  • Experiência com sistema integrado, SAP ECC e Tax One será diferencial.


Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:


  • Formação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência comprovada na área fiscal;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Office (Work, PowerPoint e Excel);


Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:


  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Refeição no Local
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

title: Full Time Job- ServiceNow ITOM Consultant/ Developer @ Sao Paulo or Curitiba (Hybrid- 3 days Onsite)
description:
Job Title: ServiceNow ITOM Consultant/ Developer

Location: Brazil- Sao Paulo or Curitiba (Hybrid- 3 days Onsite)

Employment Type: Full Time


Role Overview:

The ITOM Consultant will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing IT Operations Management solutions using ServiceNow. This role supports transformation programs for clients such as Petrobras and Banco Bradesco, focusing on infrastructure visibility, automation, and operational resilience.


Key Responsibilities:

• Implement and support ITOM modules: Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB Health.

• Develop automation strategies using Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and Orchestrator.

• Collaborate with ITSM and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration and service continuity.

• Conduct workshops and roadmap sessions with stakeholders to align platform investments with business goals.

• Monitor and improve CMDB accuracy, service visibility, and event correlation.

• Lead platform upgrades and configuration of new features.


Required Skills:

• Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITOM and ITSM modules.

• Experience with SLO/SLI, DataDog, Azure, and cloud infrastructure monitoring.

• Proficiency in scripting (JavaScript, PowerShell), API integrations, and platform analytics.

• Familiarity with ITIL processes and enterprise service management platforms (e.g., BMC, OpenText).


Certifications

• CSA – Certified System Administrator

• CIS ITOM – Discovery, Event Management, or Service Mapping

• Optional: CIS ITSM, DevOps, Cloud Security


Preferred Experience:

• 2+ years in ITOM/ITSM consulting or delivery roles.

• Experience in large-scale transformation programs (e.g., Petrobras, Bradesco).

• Proven success in automation, infrastructure modernization, and CMDB optimization.


Soft Skills:

• Analytical and solution-oriented mindset.

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement.

• Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.


Performance Indicators:

• CMDB Health Score improvement (target: >90% accuracy).

• Reduction in manual discovery and event noise.

• SLA adherence and service reliability metrics (SLO/SLI).

• Successful deployment of ITOM modules within agreed timelines.

title: Analista de Subcontratos (Atuação em Obras)
description:
Estamos com duas oportunidades de Analista de Subcontratos , para atuar em obras nas regiões de Recife/PE e São José da Tapera/AL . Estes/as profissionais terão estas principais atribuições:


  • Apoiar na interpretação de Módulos de Engenharia do Projeto, buscando contratar os serviços dentro do prazo e custo previstos;
  • Comparar cotações, escolhendo a que melhor se ajusta aos requisitos contratuais, buscando referências com a equipe de Produção;
  • Negociar contratos, definindo responsabilidades frente aos riscos, e que busquem se ajustar a modalidade de contratação junto ao Cliente;
  • Realizar a correta administração dos pagamentos e adiantamentos contratuais, favorecendo o fluxo de caixa (liquidez);
  • Realizar a Administração Contratual junto aos subcontratados assegurando o cumprimento de todas as obrigações e deveres, mitigando a incidência de passivos (contratuais, técnicos, ambientais, trabalhista e etc.).


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Necessário ter experiência profissional pregressa na área de Subcontratos em empresas do ramo de Construção Civil;
  • Dominar as diversas estruturas de modalidades contratuais;
  • Possuir domínio de todos os documentos contratuais (contrato, proposta técnica/econômica, aditivos, leis, legislações, normas, seguros e fianças, etc.);
  • Deter conhecimentos avançados dos principais softwares do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Necessário ter disponibilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial nas cidades de Recife/PE e/ou São José da Tapera/AL.



Sobre a Odebrecht :


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura :


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Public Relations Account Coordinator
description:
Esenca is a strategic communications agency based in Brazil. We work with companies across Latin America to design and execute PR, content, and brand experience strategies. Our clients range from startups to large companies in tech, crypto, and finance. We move fast, we work close to the business, and we focus on building strong, relevant brands.


We’re looking for a Public Relations Coordinator to join our team. You’ll be responsible for planning, coordinating, and, when necessary, executing strategies for media and stakeholder engagement, strengthening the brand’s reputation with the press and other relevant audiences, working across different client accounts, and supporting the day-to-day of the PR manager.


Main Responsibilities

• Team Coordination

Work collaboratively with external communications teams, guiding and contributing to the effective execution of daily tasks such as planning, press release distribution, pitch suggestions, article production, meeting notes and agendas, reports, and other PR-related routines.

• Strategic PR Planning

Develop and implement institutional communication plans focused on public relations initiatives.

• Press and Media Management

Build and maintain relationships with journalists, influencers, columnists, and media outlets.

Review, guide, and, when needed, write and distribute press releases, official statements, and institutional articles.

Guide and coordinate interviews, media briefings, press conferences, and media training for spokespeople.

• Crisis Management

Act proactively and reactively in reputation crisis situations, developing contingency plans and public response strategies.

• Institutional Relations

Guide and promote engagement efforts with partners, trade associations, government bodies, and other stakeholders.

Represent the company at events, talks, trade fairs, and strategic forums.

• Events and Brand Activations

Support or lead corporate events, inaugurations, awards, roadshows, and institutional actions involving brand image.

• Reputation Monitoring

Track and analyze media and social media mentions of the company, producing brand image performance reports.

Use clipping and media monitoring tools to report on PR campaign results.


Requirements

• Degree in Public Relations, Journalism, or Social Communication.

• Proven prior experience in leadership or coordination roles in PR.

• Established relationships with the press.

• Strong organizational and project management skills.

• Good communication and ability to work with different teams and clients.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong skills in crisis management and institutional positioning.

• Comfortable with fast-paced environments and multitasking.

• Knowledge of PR tools (e.g., I’Max, PressManager, Google Alerts, etc.).

• Fluent in Portuguese and English.


Compensations & Benefits

• Employment type: CLT Hybrid (remote with 2x/week in-office in Osasco/SP).

• Multibenefits allowance card.

• Life insurance.


Hiring Process

• Application review and screening based on requirements.

• First interview (in person and in English).

• Skills assessment.

• Final interview with the CEO and hiring.

- Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID;

- Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluindo uso de serviços como ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3 ou CloudWatch;

- Vivência com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS) para integração entre sistemas e processamento assíncrono;

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis);

- Prática em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e versionamento com Git;

- Experiência com conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integração e performance);

- Desejável: conhecimento em NodeJS para integrações leves, APIs RESTful e documentação com Swagger/OpenAPI;

- Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) será um diferencial;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (6 Month FTC)
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

Please note this is a 6-month fixed-term contract role.


The Opportunity

Are you passionate about recruiting top talent for Tech and Product roles? Join our global business at Cint as a Talent Acquisition Partner, where you will support our R&D (Tech and Product) teams. Our Talent Acquisition (TA) function is critical to our success, as it enables us to attract and hire the right talent that drives our business forward. In this role, you will proactively manage the recruitment process, working closely with business leaders to attract and hire the best candidates for our commercial and finance functions.


The Team

You will be part of an established global TA team comprising both technical and non-technical recruiters. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, where we support one another, share information, and celebrate successes. We continuously evaluate and improve our processes to ensure we remain at the forefront of talent acquisition.

Join us at Cint and be a part of a dynamic team that plays a vital role in our global success. If you are ready to take on the challenge and drive the recruitment of top technical talent, apply now!


What You Will Do

  • Full-Cycle Recruitment: Lead and execute the entire recruitment process for roles within our Tech and Product functions.
  • Consultative Partnership: Work closely with hiring managers, People Partners, and Finance Partners to share industry trends, compensation insights, and competitor updates.
  • Educate Hiring Managers: Provide guidance on best practices, recruitment strategies, and process improvements to enhance their hiring practices.
  • End-to-End Process Management: Manage all aspects of the hiring process, including writing job advertisements, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, arranging interviews, and extending job offers.
  • ATS Management: Maintain and update our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) – SmartRecruiters.
  • Support DEI: Promote and support Cint’s commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) through continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Engage in projects with the TA team to implement process changes that enhance our ability to identify and attract talent.
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Analyze your performance metrics to identify strengths and areas for development, and share these insights with the team.
Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: Proven experience in a talent acquisition/recruiting role, managing end-to-end recruitment for commercial vacancies in Brazil/North America.
  • Commercial & Finance Insight: Understanding the importance of the Tech/Engineering and Product functions within a global business.
  • ATS Proficiency: Ability to maintain and manage an accurate ATS.
  • Data-Driven Approach: Ability to analyze performance metrics and use data to drive recruitment strategies.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong team player who can collaborate effectively to address challenges and develop solutions.
  • Proactive Sourcing: Willingness to source candidates proactively to find the right expertise.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • ATS Experience: Previous experience using the Smart Recruiters ATS.
Additional Information


Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (

title: Analista de Riscos e Seguros
description:
Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Somos uma consultoria que une inteligência de riscos e soluções em seguros com o propósito de proteger empresas e pessoas em um mundo que se renova a cada instante. Em nossa trajetória de mais de 45 anos atuando em projetos de alta complexidade, o que nos move são os desafios de nossos clientes e a convicção de que podemos atuar diretamente na transformação de incertezas em oportunidades por meio da criação de soluções sob medida, qualificadas e inovadoras. Quer nos conhecer melhor?

Acesse: e saiba mais sobre nossa atuação e Nossa Cultura .


Buscamos um/a Analista de Riscos e Seguros que atuará na gestão de riscos e corretagem de seguros dos nossos clientes LATAM dos segmentos de Infraestrutura e do mercado de Energia.


✅ Os interessados podem se candidatar aqui, por meio desta vaga em nosso LinkedIn.

✅ Conhece alguém com este perfil? Compartilhe esta oportunidade.


Na Horiens, este/a profissional será responsável por apoiar os processos de gestão de riscos, definir e implementar as estratégias de transferência dos riscos seguráveis (na íntegra dos processos de corretagem de seguros, como colocação, inspeção de riscos e regulação de sinistros), buscando viabilizar a melhor relação custo-benefício para os clientes, tendo estas atividades principais:


  • Realizar as análises dos riscos contratuais de modo a garantir a correta alocação dos riscos entre os stakeholders envolvidos;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar os programas de seguros de cada cliente e definir suas estratégias de contratação, de forma a garantir que estejam de acordo com as necessidades;
  • Elaborar orçamentos de seguros para os clientes a partir da análise dos riscos identificados e seguráveis, considerando o cenário do mercado (res)segurador e a melhor relação entre custo e coberturas securitárias;
  • Programar e participar das inspeções de risco, acompanhando a implementação das recomendações feitas e as eventuais alterações do risco que possam impactar o programa de seguros contratado;
  • Manter atualizados os sistemas da Horiens com as apólices de seguros negociadas, de forma a garantir o arquivamento adequado dos dados das transações realizadas ao longo do período de vigência.


Para este desafio conosco gostaríamos do seguinte perfil:

  • Experiência anterior como Analista de Riscos e Seguros
  • Formação Superior completa preferencialmente nos ramos da Engenharia, Administração ou Direito
  • Idiomas: inglês e espanhol fluentes
  • Sólidos conhecimentos sobre processos de colocação de (res)seguro, assim como sobre a atuação do mercado ressegurador
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe


Diferenciais:

  • Cursos e / ou certificações técnicas em (res)seguros e gestão de riscos
  • Cursos e / ou certificações do mercado de Energia


Conheça alguns dos benefícios que oferecemos para você e sua família:

  • Jornada de trabalho flexível e em modelo híbrido (3x2)
  • Plano de Previdência Privada para você atuar hoje no seu futuro

  • Wellhub (Gympass) para promover o cuidado com a saúde
  • Seguro de Vida

  • Outros seguros pessoais opcionais, com valores diferenciados (como seguro residencial, seguro-viagem e seguro de acidentes pessoais)
  • Somos parte do Empresa Cidadã, programa que oferece licença estendida de maternidade (180 dias) e de paternidade (20 dias)
  • Auxílio creche mensal (até 12 meses)
  • Diversas parcerias e convênios que oferecem descontos em serviços e produtos

title: Especialista em Vendas (Cidadania Italiana - serviços consular) – Sorocaba (Presencial)
description:
Você já trabalhou diretamente com processos de cidadania italiana, AIRE, busca de documentos na Itália ou serviços consulares?  Esta vaga é para você.

A Nacionalitália é uma empresa especializada no reconhecimento da cidadania italiana, oferecendo assessoria completa para quem deseja conquistar esse direito com segurança e eficiência.

Estamos expandindo nossa atuação com um novo hub físico em Sorocaba  e buscamos um profissional de vendas que já conheça este mercado para se juntar a nós. Queremos pessoas responsáveis, autônomas e motivadas , que desejem crescer em uma equipe sólida, trabalhando lado a lado com os CEOs da empresa.

Sobre a vaga

Procuramos um Sales Consultant  para integrar nosso time. Sua principal missão será transformar o sonho da cidadania em realidade para nossos clientes.

Como especialista na área, seu processo de integração será rápido.  Você já entende a complexidade e o valor do nosso serviço: a pesquisa e organização de documentos italianos e brasileiros.

Inicialmente, você será responsável por:

  • Atender prospects inbound  (que entram em contato com a empresa);
  • Entender as necessidades do cliente , aplicando seu conhecimento prévio sobre cidadania italiana, AIRE e documentação;
  • Conduzir reuniões iniciais  de apresentação dos serviços e esclarecer dúvidas básicas;
  • Direcionar  os interessados para reuniões mais detalhadas com nosso time de especialistas ;
  • Com o tempo, e conforme seu desenvolvimento, você poderá assumir vendas diretas  e realizar atendimentos completos , tornando-se um especialista em processos de cidadania italiana e serviços consulares .

Com sua evolução, você assumirá vendas diretas  de outros serviços jurídicos e de cidadania, além de apoiar o pós-venda e atividades administrativas  ligadas ao contato com o cliente.

Responsabilidades

  • Identificar e qualificar oportunidades de vendas;
  • Construir e manter relacionamento estratégico com potenciais clientes;
  • Agendar reuniões entre prospects e a equipe comercial;
  • Gerenciar e registrar todas as interações no CRM da empresa;
  • Realizar follow-ups estruturados para conversão de leads;
  • Trabalhar junto à equipe de vendas para aprimorar estratégias comerciais;
  • Apoiar no pós-venda e em atividades administrativas.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos como SDR ou em vendas consultivas de serviços de alto valor;
  • Experiência profissional comprovada com processos de cidadania italiana é um requisito obrigatório;
  • Perfil autônomo, responsável e orientado a resultados;
  • Desejo de crescer em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo;
  • Candidatos sem experiência direta no mercado de cidadania italiana não serão considerados para esta posição;
  • Conhecimento básico de italiano será valorizado (não obrigatório).

O que oferecemos

  • Contrato CLT (presencial em Sorocaba);
  • Salário fixo Inserção : R$ 2.700
  • Comissão média de R$ 3.500 (variável conforme desempenho);
  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição + Vale Transporte;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar diretamente com os CEOs  da empresa;
  • Ambiente colaborativo e real oportunidade de crescimento profissional.

title: Especialista de Engenharia de Aplicação Válvulas
description:
Regime de trabalho: Presencial - CLT


A Alutal é uma empresa nacional, especializada na fabricação e comercialização de sensores e instrumentos para medição, monitoramento e controle de temperatura, nível, vazão, vibração, analítica em caldeiras, válvulas, pressão e detecção de gases.

Atuando no mercado há mais de 30 anos, a Alutal está situada em uma área de mais de 2.000m² na cidade de Votorantim/SP - 100 km da capital - e atende os mais exigentes segmentos da indústria como Óleo & Gás/Onshore & Offshore, Químicas & Petroquímicas, Plantas de Geração De Energia Elétrica, Siderúrgicas & Fundições, Mineração, Açúcar & Álcool e OEM.


Responsabilidades:

·       Analisar as necessidades técnicas dos clientes e propor soluções completas e customizadas com foco em válvulas industriais, garantindo aderência às especificações e às condições de processo apresentadas;

·       Elaborar propostas comerciais e técnicas detalhadas, com clareza na apresentação de produtos, aplicações, condições de fornecimento e diferenciais técnicos;

·       Realizar o dimensionamento técnico de válvulas conforme normas vigentes, considerando fluido, pressão, temperatura e demais parâmetros operacionais;

·       Elaborar e revisar folhas de dados, desenhos técnicos e documentação de apoio, assegurando a completude, atualização e aderência ao projeto do cliente;

·       Propor alternativas técnicas e comerciais que agreguem valor à solução, otimizando prazos e melhorando o custo-benefício;

·       Atuar em conjunto com a engenharia interna e fornecedores para validação técnica e viabilidade das soluções ofertadas;

·       Colaborar com a gerência de vendas na definição de estratégias de precificação, margem e posicionamento técnico frente à concorrência;

·       Prestar suporte técnico e consultivo à equipe comercial em todas as fases do ciclo de vendas, incluindo reuniões com clientes e esclarecimentos técnicos de propostas;

·       Manter comunicação eficaz com áreas como planejamento, engenharia, logística e pós-vendas, assegurando alinhamento e sinergia na execução dos projetos;

·       Participar ativamente no desenvolvimento e melhoria contínua de processos e ferramentas de aplicação técnica.


Requerimentos do Cargo:

·       Formação superior completa em Engenharia (Mecânica, Controle e Automação, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas);

·       Conhecimentos avançados em dimensionamento de válvulas e aplicações industriais;

·       Pacote MS Office intermediário a avançado;

·       Leitura e escrita em inglês técnico (nível intermediário ou avançado);

·       Experiência mínima de 5 anos em aplicação técnica e comercial de válvulas industriais;


Expectativas de você nesta função:

·       Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica;

·       Comunicação clara e didática, inclusive em contextos técnicos complexos;

·       Proatividade, autonomia e orientação a resultados;

·       Facilidade para trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar;

·       Habilidade em apresentações técnicas e negociações de alto nível;

·       Organização, disciplina e atenção a detalhes.


O que oferecemos a você:

description:

With six lines of business, four international hubs and five international delivery centres, Phi has become a leading global financial markets IT services provider within our niche domains. Our international sales team run out of Wrotham Business Park in London where we have over 30 sales consultants covering the broad range of business lines, clients and geographies. This team includes junior sales personnel who focus primarily on candidate research and recruitment whilst they are being trained to become client-facing sales consultants and eventually account managers. We are now expanding out Sales & Research team to include a team in our São Paulo office!


Phi offers our clients a comprehensive range of services including staff augmentation, advisory, project and managed services. These deals range from £100,000 to £20,000,000 in size, creating huge revenue and earnings opportunities.


Role and Career Opportunities

Phi has an ongoing commitment to growth in terms of client acquisition, geographical reach, and evolution of our lines of business and service catalogue. To support our ambitions, we take on four cohorts of junior sales consultants each year, in January, April, July, and October. Each consultant is trained the “Phi way”.


We are looking for talent who are either fresh out of university or in the early stages of their careers. Subject to meeting reasonable competency and performance targets, you can expect regular opportunities for advancement throughout your journey:


  • In the first 6 months you will be in our London Office being trained by our leadership team.
  • Initially, you will focus on candidate research and recruitment. After six months, you will be allocated to a line of business, allowing you to become a specialist recruiter within that field. Training that is specific to the line of business will allow you to master your ability to converse confidently with client and internal specialists.
  • After a period of between 12-18 months, you can expect to begin your move into client-facing sales. You will be allocated a small number of clients specific to your line of business, beginning your journey with client research, leading into full client engagement if the client is approved as a target.
  • Once you have closed deals with clients (bringing master services agreements between the client and Phi), you will begin to generate P&L. Subject to competency and revenue targets, you will complete your move into sales. We expect this phase to take between 18-24 months, and you will be supported on your journey by more senior sales leads, a deal architecture / pre-sales team, and the subject-matter-experts from within the delivery teams.
  • As a fully-fledged sales consultant, you will be part of a smaller group of 10, that are some of the best in the world. You will manage your client portfolio and may be given an expanded scope of clients giving you the room to really become a true success. Depending on results, you may be allocated one or two strategic key accounts, with the greatest potential for growth. These accounts are global, and relevant for multiple lines of business. They will bring a large portfolio, driving significant P&L and earnings.


Our most successful salespeople will make Partner at Phi, giving access to stock in the company that is granted annually based on a transparent assessment of contribution. Within the sales team we have three partners today, all of whom came through the graduate program, and we except two more to get promoted in 2025. The sky is the limit at Phi for the most ambitions and driven!


What we are looking for

Commitment and drive

We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to succeed, and who are prepared to do “whatever it takes”. We are looking for problem solvers who have the ability to “find a way” to solve any challenge; people who won’t give up when the going gets tough! To become successful, it will take a long time to develop the required skills to be independent and to operate autonomously. So, we are looking for people who are truly committed and driven. These are all skills that you will have had life-long, applied and improved over many years. We will be looking to understand what drives you at a fundamental level, as this is what you will rely on to succeed.


Communication and charisma

Our sales consultants must be great communicators: people who have natural confidence with person-to-person communication, from over-the-phone interactions to directing meetings with senior stakeholders. You will need to be charismatic and confident. An ability to develop meaningful and relationships built on respect and trust is critical.


Team spirit

At Phi we have maintained a “small company” mindset and feel, with an excellent team spirit – we work together, we socialize together, we support each other. Our appreciation for the wider Phi community makes us stronger than the sum of our parts. We are looking for people who will naturally be at home as part of a strong team – who can understand our values, contribute to the wider Phi community, share knowledge, and put the team before themselves. We will be looking for evidence of this, academically, professionally, or outside (such as sport).


Life at Phi

Phi is an established business but feels like a start-up, specially being part of our brand-new team in Brazil. Your base will be in São Paulo, but as you develop into client-facing sales, you will spend time out of the office and will have opportunities for regular international travel.


Our family mentality means that even the most junior at Phi has access to the senior leadership team. We are approachable. You will be on first name terms with the CRO and CEO. Beyond the sales team, you will work within a wider community across pre-sales and delivery, specific to your clients and your line-of-business.


Our company thrives in having a diverse and international staff and this is especially true in our London office, where the Sales & Research team is located. Our sales consultants come from all parts of the world and there is a vibrant and youthful atmosphere. The atmosphere is dynamic and busy (punctual starts and hard work are inevitable), but always friendly. We socialize regularly outside office hours. Many of the senior team members at Phi have known each other for decades, and people who are the right fit for Phi can expect to build friendships that will last a lifetime. The goal is to build a similar environment in our new operation in Brazil!


Training and Reward

You can expect initial and ongoing training, in a well-designed, competency-based framework with a comprehensive and growing learning and development library. You can expect to be carefully performance-managed using our proprietary tools, ensuring that your contributions are fairly measured and that you are supported in your drive to succeed in any areas that need developing.


We offer competitive salaries and the best commission structure in the market. We have a simple and straightforward commission model that rewards you for what you generate. With no caps, your earning potential is unlimited.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

Degree in Information Technology, Process Engineering, or related fields.

title: CONSULTOR(A) EXCELENCIA OPERACIONAL I - Frotas e Ativos Móveis Florestais
description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.


PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!


DADOS:

Local: Limeira ou Escritório Central - SP

Inscrições até: 19/10/2025


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Estruturar, padronizar e evoluir o modelo técnico de gestão de ativos móveis, garantindo integração de dados, rastreabilidade e eficiência operacional em todo o ciclo de vida dos equipamentos;
  • Gerir tecnicamente as aquisições de CAPEX e contratos via IFRS16 (leasing/rental), conduzindo avaliações técnico-econômicas, modelagens de TCO, análises rent vs. buy e recomendações estratégicas de investimento;
  • Elaborar e revisar especificações e escopos técnicos para aquisição de equipamentos e implementos florestais, assegurando aderência às diretrizes corporativas e compatibilidade entre unidades operacionais;
  • Coordenar a interface técnica com Unidades, Suprimentos, Engenharia, Jurídico, Finanças e Contabilidade, garantindo compliance técnico, contabilização correta e mitigação de riscos em todo o processo;
  • Acompanhar o ciclo completo dos ativos — da avaliação técnica à devolução, substituição ou desinvestimento — assegurando governança, controle de provisões e alinhamento ao plano de CAPEX;
  • Aplicar metodologias de Custo Total de Propriedade (TCO) e de Análise de Valor Econômico (VPL, Payback), promovendo decisões sustentáveis e tecnicamente embasadas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização técnica e financeira, padronizando soluções e antecipando demandas futuras das operações florestais e logísticas;
  • Conduzir análises comparativas de desempenho (benchmarking), estudos de viabilidade e simulações de portfólio, subsidiando decisões estratégicas de investimento;
  • Manter relacionamento técnico com fornecedores e stakeholders, promovendo workshops, programas de inovação e iniciativas de melhoria contínua;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e estratégica em gestão de frotas e ativos móveis, fomentando cultura de aprendizado, padronização e excelência operacional.


QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa e proatividade;
  • Que tenha facilidade com comunicação e negociação;
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de síntese, visão sistêmica, foco em resultados e equilíbrio entre visão técnica e negócio;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.


O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Formação Superior Completa (preferencialmente em Engenharias);
  • Experiência em Projetos de transformação e melhoria de processos em ambientes industriais com múltiplas unidades e interfaces complexas;
  • Conhecimento em TCO, VPL, Payback, modelagem técnico-econômica, Lean, PDCA, análise de causa raiz;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office e Power BI;
  • Inglês desejável.


NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:

title: Gerente de Infraestrutura - TI
description:
We Are PepsiCo

Join PepsiCo and Dare for Better! We are the perfect place for curious people, thinkers and change agents. From leadership to front lines, we're excited about the future and working together to make the world a better place.

Being part of PepsiCo means being part of one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with our iconic brands consumed more than a billion times a day in more than 200 countries.

A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where all people are welcome. Here, you can dare to be you. No matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love, you can always influence the people around you and make a positive impact in the world.

Know more: PepsiCoJobs

Join PepsiCo, dare for better.



The Opportunity

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Infrastructure and Operations Senior Manager for Brazil to lead and evolve our global IT infrastructure and operations landscape. This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our technology environment for Brazil. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise, strong leadership capabilities, and a passion for operational excellence in a fast-paced, multinational setting.



Your Impact

Strategic Leadership

• Define and execute the global infrastructure and operations strategy aligned with business goals.

• Lead transformation initiatives, including cloud migration, automation, and modernization of legacy systems.

• Collaborate with senior stakeholders across IT, security, and Brazil business units to ensure alignment and value delivery.

Infrastructure Management

• Oversee data centers, cloud platforms, network architecture, and enterprise systems for Brazil.

• Ensure high availability, performance, and scalability of Brazil's infrastructure services.

• Manage vendor relationships and service level agreements (SLAs).

Operational Excellence

• Lead IT operations, including incident management, change management, and problem resolution.

• Implement and monitor KPIs to drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.

• Ensure compliance with global standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

• Build and mentor a high-performing infrastructure and operations team in Brazil.

• Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and collaboration.

• Manage budgets, resource planning, and talent development.




Who Are We Looking For?

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

• 10+ years of experience in IT infrastructure and operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.

• Proven experience in managing global infrastructure in a multinational environment.


Technical Skills

Infrastructure & Cloud

• Deep expertise in cloud platforms: Azure and AWS (architecture, migration, cost optimization).

• Strong understanding of hybrid cloud and multi-cloud environments.

• Experience with virtualization technologies.

Networking

• Advanced knowledge of LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, firewalls, load balancers, and network segmentation.

• Familiarity with Cisco, and other enterprise-grade networking solutions.


Systems & Platforms

• Proficiency in Windows Server and Linux environments.

• Experience with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and identity management.

• Define and execute the strategy for end-user devices and services.

• Strong understanding of ITIL and Agile

Leadership & Communication

• Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to problem-solving.

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic, matrixed, and culturally diverse organization.

• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.



What can you expect from us:

  • Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.
  • Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning.
  • Development programs according to Leadership skills.
  • Specialized training according to the role.
  • Learning experiences with internal and external providers.
  • We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.
  • Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life.
  • A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.
  • And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

title: Field Senior Account Sales Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Cognex is the world’s leading provider of vision systems, software, sensors, and industrial barcode readers used in manufacturing automation. Cognex vision helps companies improve product quality, eliminate production errors, lower manufacturing costs, and exceed consumer expectations for high quality products at an affordable price. Typical applications for machine vision include detecting defects, monitoring production lines, guiding assembly robots, and tracking, sorting and identifying parts.

Cognex serves an international customer base from offices located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, and through a global network of integration and distribution partners. The company is headquartered close to Boston in Natick, Massachusetts, USA.

Cognex is a financially strong international company with a culture that maintains the fast-paced, creative environment of a startup. Its employees, proudly called “Cognoids,” take their work seriously, but don't take themselves seriously. Their ‘Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast’ culture recognizes employees for their innovation, perseverance & hard work in a fun & rewarding environment. Cognex values in-person team collaboration, whilst offering remote workplace flexibility up to two days a week depending on the role.


Essential Functions:

  • Properly forecast and close vision solutions opportunities with End Users, Partners, and OEMs to reach the quota goal.
  • Utilize the Cognex sales process to effectively demonstrate products to customers and winning large strategic opportunities.
  • Follows up on sales leads and schedules customer visits, seeking out large opportunities.
  • Effectively conducts customer visits in a solution sales environment.
  • Collaborate with counterparts from other territories on opportunities that are either integrated or installed in a different territory or where the decision makers do not reside in the Account Manager’s territory.
  • Follow up on customer inquiries, understand system requirements, and differentiate the Cognex solution.
  • Assists at trade shows and other marketing events.
  • Coordinate evaluations utilizing the Applications Engineering team.
  • Maintain and continuously update project information in Sales Book.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Proven track record of sales performance in the automation or similar industry.
  • Proven track record of operating in a solutions sales environment.
  • Uses defined sales process to deliver desired results on a consistent basis.
  • PC literate with a working knowledge of MS Windows applications.
  • Ability to travel 40% of the time is required.
  • Ability to work independently is required.


Minimum education and work experience required:

  • Technical Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven sales experience and a good track record for exceeding sales targets is required.
  • Experience in selling technical products to all levels of an organization is required.
  • Experience in selling vision products is also preferred.

title: Field Senior Account Sales Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Cognex is the world’s leading provider of vision systems, software, sensors, and industrial barcode readers used in manufacturing automation. Cognex vision helps companies improve product quality, eliminate production errors, lower manufacturing costs, and exceed consumer expectations for high quality products at an affordable price. Typical applications for machine vision include detecting defects, monitoring production lines, guiding assembly robots, and tracking, sorting and identifying parts.

Cognex serves an international customer base from offices located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, and through a global network of integration and distribution partners. The company is headquartered close to Boston in Natick, Massachusetts, USA.

Cognex is a financially strong international company with a culture that maintains the fast-paced, creative environment of a startup. Its employees, proudly called “Cognoids,” take their work seriously, but don't take themselves seriously. Their ‘Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast’ culture recognizes employees for their innovation, perseverance & hard work in a fun & rewarding environment. Cognex values in-person team collaboration, whilst offering remote workplace flexibility up to two days a week depending on the role.


Essential Functions:

  • Properly forecast and close vision solutions opportunities with End Users, Partners, and OEMs to reach the quota goal.
  • Utilize the Cognex sales process to effectively demonstrate products to customers and winning large strategic opportunities.
  • Follows up on sales leads and schedules customer visits, seeking out large opportunities.
  • Effectively conducts customer visits in a solution sales environment.
  • Collaborate with counterparts from other territories on opportunities that are either integrated or installed in a different territory or where the decision makers do not reside in the Account Manager’s territory.
  • Follow up on customer inquiries, understand system requirements, and differentiate the Cognex solution.
  • Assists at trade shows and other marketing events.
  • Coordinate evaluations utilizing the Applications Engineering team.
  • Maintain and continuously update project information in Sales Book.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Proven track record of sales performance in the automation or similar industry.
  • Proven track record of operating in a solutions sales environment.
  • Uses defined sales process to deliver desired results on a consistent basis.
  • PC literate with a working knowledge of MS Windows applications.
  • Ability to travel 40% of the time is required.
  • Ability to work independently is required.


Minimum education and work experience required:

  • Technical Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven sales experience and a good track record for exceeding sales targets is required.
  • Experience in selling technical products to all levels of an organization is required.
  • Experience in selling vision products is also preferred.

title: Analista Supply Chain
description:
Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.


Objetivo do Cargo:


O(a) Analista de Supply III será responsável por liderar iniciativas em toda a cadeia de Procure-to-Pay dentro do setor de Oil & Gas, garantindo processos de aquisição eficientes, compliance regulatório e geração de valor por meio da negociação, desenvolvimento de fornecedores e identificação de oportunidades de savings. Atuará de forma transversal, conectando-se com clientes internos, auditoria, análise de custos e estratégia de suprimentos, com foco em excelência operacional, sustentabilidade da cadeia e alinhamento às metas organizacionais.



Responsabilidades


Procura & Negociação:


  • Liderar processos de Procura para categorias definidas, conduzindo análises de mercado, RFPs, RFQs e negociações complexas, incluindo elaboração de Ordens de Compra de acordo com os termos e condições acordados.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com fornecedores-chave, garantindo performance, entregas no prazo, inovação e mitigação de riscos.
  • Definir e executar estratégias de savings, por meio da análise de gastos, otimizando custos e promovendo eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Implementar contratos e SLAs alinhados às políticas corporativas e às necessidades do negócio.


Análise & Gestão de Performance:


  • Conduzir análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO) e estudos comparativos de fornecedores.
  • Gerenciar dados de procura e gastos, identificando tendências, oportunidades de savings e alavancas de negociação.
  • Garantir a qualidade das informações em sistemas de gestão (ERP, tracking e dashboards de performance).
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e recomendações para a liderança, baseados em dados e benchmarks.


Stakeholder Management & Comunicação:


  • Atuar como ponto focal entre fornecedores, áreas operacionais e stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento com áreas clientes para definição de prioridades e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Fornecer suporte em processos de auditoria externa e interna relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos.


Liderança & Desenvolvimento:


  • Promover boas práticas de Procura e Compliance junto ao time e stakeholders.
  • Participar ativamente de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, propondo inovações em processos, ferramentas e estratégias de compras.
  • Apoiar treinamentos internos e o desenvolvimento de capacidades em Procurement e Strategic Sourcing.



Requisitos


Obrigatórios:


  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Strategic Sourcing, Procurement ou Supply Chain dentro do setor de Oil & Gás.
  • Forte conhecimento em negociação, gestão de contratos e análise financeira.
  • Domínio de ERP (preferencialmente JDE ou Oracle) e ferramentas analíticas (Excel avançado, Power BI).
  • Inglês fluente.



Desejáveis:


  • Certificações (CPSM, CSCP, CFA ou similares).
  • Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.
  • Vivência em empresas globais e ambientes multiculturais.
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre gestão de estoques.



Competências & Habilidades:


  • Visão estratégica aliada à execução tática.
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Habilidade de negociação e influência em diferentes níveis.
  • Organização, gestão de múltiplas prioridades e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Comunicação clara, assertiva e foco em relacionamento colaborativo.
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão.

Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.

Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).

Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

title: General Manager

Operations Manager

Location: Curitiba – 100% on-site


Position Purpose

We are seeking an Operations Manager to lead the full operations of an established industrial company based in Curitiba. This role carries full P&L responsibility, overseeing production, engineering, services, quality, logistics, and PCP. The Operations Manager will lead a team of approximately 70 employees, including 2 managers and 2 coordinators, ensuring efficiency, profitability, and continuous improvement across all operational areas. This position reports directly to the CEO in Brazil, with a dotted-line reporting to the VP in Europe.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full P&L ownership, ensuring financial performance, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth.
  • Leadership of production, engineering, services, quality, logistics, and PCP, promoting excellence in safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
  • Development and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization programs.
  • Ensure operational alignment with corporate strategies and standards defined by headquarters in Europe.
  • Drive team performance, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs and governance systems to ensure data-driven decision-making and transparency.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between operations, sales, and service delivery.
  • Represent the operations area in strategic discussions and report performance results to executive management.


Requirements and Qualifications

  • Proven experience in industrial operations management, ideally within manufacturing or industrial equipment sectors.
  • Solid background managing multiple operational functions (production, engineering, logistics, quality, services, PCP).
  • Demonstrated leadership of large teams (50+ employees), including managers and coordinators.
  • Strong financial acumen and previous experience with P&L management.
  • Experience in process improvement, Lean Manufacturing, or operational excellence programs.
  • Advanced proficiency in English (mandatory) to interact with global leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Production, or Business Administration; MBA is a plus.


Skills and Competencies

  • Strategic and analytical mindset, capable of transforming operational challenges into growth opportunities.
  • Hands-on leadership style, promoting engagement and continuous improvement on the shop floor.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills across different levels of the organization.
  • Resilient and results-driven, with a strong focus on execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural environment and collaborate with global stakeholders.
